# Cross Buck Construction

> Cross Buck Construction (two words) is a contractor based in Wolfforth, Texas, serving West Texas and Eastern New Mexico, from Hobbs, NM to Sweetwater to Amarillo to Muleshoe, TX. Licensed electrician. Nine trades: electrical, solar, welding, equipment operating and dirt work, corrals, fences and gates, concrete and framing, plumbing, and general property work. Call or text (806) 496-6999. Email email@crossbuckconstruction.com.

Key facts:
- Name: Cross Buck Construction (two words; not affiliated with Crossbuck Construction Company LLC of Napoleon, Ohio)
- Base: Wolfforth, TX (service-area business; no public street address)
- Towns served: Wolfforth, Lubbock, Brownfield, Lamesa, Midland, Odessa, Big Spring, Snyder, Sweetwater, Amarillo and Muleshoe, Texas; Hobbs, New Mexico
- Owner: Zach, licensed electrician and operator, 28 years in construction
- Emergencies: We're open, day or night, for emergencies.
- Phone: (806) 496-6999

## Services
- [Electrical](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/electrical-west-texas.html): Cross Buck Construction, Wolfforth, TX: licensed electrician for panel upgrades, EV chargers and shop wiring in West Texas and Eastern NM. (806) 496-6999
- [Solar](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/solar-west-texas.html): Cross Buck Construction, Wolfforth, TX: solar panel arrays on houses and solar well installs across West Texas and Eastern New Mexico. (806) 496-6999
- [Welding](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/welding-west-texas.html): Welding for gates, pipe fence, equipment and ranch steel. Zach does the welding. Serving West Texas and Eastern New Mexico. Call (806) 496-6999.
- [Operating and dirt work](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/operating-dirt-work-west-texas.html): Operating and dirt work: caliche roads, dig and dump, trenching, clearing and pipeline. Wolfforth-based, West Texas and Eastern NM. (806) 496-6999
- [Corrals and pens](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/corrals-west-texas.html): Working corrals, pens, alleys and handling layouts built to match how you run cattle. Wolfforth-based, serving West Texas and Eastern NM. (806) 496-6999
- [Fences and gates](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/fences-gates-west-texas.html): New fence, rebuilds, gates and line repairs, with posts set true and the line tight. Serving West Texas and Eastern New Mexico. Call (806) 496-6999.
- [Concrete and framing](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/concrete-framing-west-texas.html): Pads, footings, flatwork, pours and framing for sheds, lean-tos, additions and ranch buildings. West Texas and Eastern New Mexico. Call (806) 496-6999.
- [Plumbing](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/plumbing-west-texas.html): Ranch and farm plumbing: water lines, livestock troughs, pipeline, shop and house lines and repairs. West Texas and Eastern NM. (806) 496-6999
- [General property work](https://crossbuckconstruction.com/property-work-west-texas.html): Odds and ends, small tear-outs, load-and-dump runs and fix-it jobs around the place. If it's legal and safe, we tell you straight. (806) 496-6999
